items.statement: The submission identifies the neutral broken-symmetry unrestricted open-shell singlet isotactic PVC model and force sites, and validates each advanced TS with one imaginary frequency plus connectivity evidence.
items.expected: Persistent XYZ atom identity, charge 0, multiplicity 1 with an explicitly tested BS-UDFT open-shell-singlet wavefunction, force sites reported, and per-candidate TS validation records.

items.statement: The force-induced HAT barrier is approximately 84.6 kJ/mol.
